dxContextBindings._note: Corporate-action surface for the 5 environment DX_CONTEXT categories (climate, biodiversity, ocean, forest, pollution). Mirrors energy-deep-directives intent: each diagnostic maps to real environmental-sector tickers, their capex cycles, policy windows, and M&A / contract-flow catalysts that turn the directive's treatment into an investable / contractable pathway. Tickers are real environmental-sector issuers; environment couples to energy via emissions/carbon but keeps environmental identity (climate/pollution/ecosystems). Additive metadata; does not alter directives.

directives.treatmentLabel: Design Climate Systems Infrastructure & Capacity Capability Maturity Model

directives.treatmentMonitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — protected area coverage using WDPA protected area database. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — protected area coverage measured biannually. Target: 30% land and sea protected. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against Kunming-Montreal GBF 30x30 target. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — protected area coverage trending toward 35% protected. Escalate if <22% protected floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Compre
directives.treatmentEscalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a climate science and adaptation specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 30 days.
